name: Demo Addon
description:
# Demo Addon

A **demo** addon manifest used for local development and testing of `@mbler/mfd`.

## Features

- Markdown introduction rendering
- Minecraft version selection
- SAPI (@minecraft/server) version mapping

## Usage

```js
import { defineConfig } from '@mbler/mfd'
export default defineConfig({
  mcVersion: { min: '1.21.0', max: '1.21.90' },
  description: '# Hello',
})
```

> Replace this file with your own manifest.addon.json when deploying.
